about.introduction: Hi, I'm Sylvio! I'm currently in my third semester at Fontys ICT studying Interactive Media. I have a big passion for web development and mobile app design — I love the idea of building things that actually make sense and help people in some way. I let my creativity and intuition guide me when crafting digital experiences.
about.interests: When I'm not coding or designing, you'll probably find me playing Overwatch, collecting Pokémon cards, or just putting on a vinyl record and chilling. I edit videos here and there too. Coffee is basically a personality trait at this point. In the winter I go skiing and in the summer I'm usually playing beach volleyball with friends.
